name: Hilda
story: Inheritor of the Power of the Megalith.

skills.name: Blessing of Wilderness
skills.desc: Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances her next Basic Attack, which deals 110 (+130% Total Physical Attack)(+12*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target, reduces the target's Movement Speed by 40%, and deals 40 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to enemies behind the target. After using the enhanced Basic Attack, this effect enters a 6s cooldown. Hilda's Basic Attack and skills apply a Wilderness Mark on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6 times. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 3%.

skills.name: Combat Ritual
skills.desc: Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3s and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% Max HP, lasting 3s.

skills.name: Art of Hunting
skills.desc: Hilda locks onto an enemy target, dealing 220 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The 2nd attack deals extra damage to nearby enemies. The 3rd attack deals damage to the target and nearby enemies, knocking them back briefly.

skills.name: Power of Wildness
skills.desc: Hilda launches a powerful slash at the target enemy, dealing 600 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.2s. Nearby enemies take 60% of the damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark increases Power of Wildness's damage by 2.5% of the target's Max HP. At max stacks, the extra damage increases to 20% of the target's Max HP.
